meaning: Definition NFT represents an exact shared definition as collectible visual card editions. Different visual variants share the same base image and exact definition version. Card transfer does not change KEP ownership, access or definition rights. Cards may be transferred or traded as collectible NFTs. Trade transfers the NFT only, not definition ownership, copyright, licenses or KEP decryption access. Exchange mechanics, pricing, royalties and marketplace implementation are not selected by this proposal; no actual trade is authorized here.
source_or_proposal: Revised local proposal with user-directed collectible variants; exact edition and transfer rules remain proposed.
